case_name: Smt Priyanka Mahlawat vs Learned District Judge And Anr

parties.respondent_defendant: The learned District Judge Bharatpur & Ors.

facts_of_case: Petitioner-wife and respondent-wife jointly filed an application under Section 13B of the Hindu Marriage Act. The matter was deferred to 11/12/2012, and the petitioner apprehends that the matter may be again adjourned.

legal_principles.principle: The court may defer a matter to another date.
legal_principles.held: It is impressed upon both the parties to appear before the court below on 11/12/2012.

legal_principles.principle: A party's apprehension or concern may be considered by the court.
legal_principles.held: It is contended that petitioner's parents have found suitable match for her for re-marriage and if decree of mutual divorce is not passed on that date, there will be difficulty in remarriage of petitioner.

outcome.final_order: The writ petition is disposed of with direction to both parties to appear before the court below on 11/12/2012, and an effort to decide the matter in accordance with law.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for mutual divorce under Hindu Marriage Act
advising on the implications of re-marriage after divorce
assisting in drafting an application for joint divorce
